description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the License Fee for Toddy Tapping; Excise Notification No. 08/2018 w.e.f. 16.04.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the establishment of new license fees for toddy tapping under the Excise Ordinance. It is a regulatory matter that creates and defines new fees and categories for commercial licenses, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the core content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
